name: transcription-agent
description: Transcribe local recordings into speaker-labeled, timestamped TXT, SRT, or JSON with Gemini, Meta, or Microsoft speech models.
long_description: Give Claude a local MP3, WAV, M4A, FLAC, or OGG recording and get back a transcript with speaker labels and timestamps, saved beside the audio as plain text, SRT subtitles, or JSON segments. Audio is sent only to the speech provider you choose: Google Gemini 3.5 Transcribe (default), Meta Muse Voice Transcribe, or Microsoft MAI-Transcribe-2. Requires FFmpeg (for example `brew install ffmpeg`). Keys you enter here are kept in secure storage; keys saved with `transcriber-cli auth set` also work.

tools.name: transcribe
tools.description: Transcribe a local recording with speaker labels and timestamps and save it as TXT, SRT, or JSON.

tools.name: auth_status
tools.description: Show which speech providers have an API key configured, without showing the keys.

gemini_api_key.title: Gemini API key
gemini_api_key.description: For the default model, gemini-3.5-transcribe. Leave empty to use a key saved with transcriber-cli.

azure_speech_key.title: Azure Speech key (optional)
azure_speech_key.description: For MAI-Transcribe-2. Also set the Azure Speech endpoint.
